_what: What the person sees about whether every copy of their things is in step (src/workspace/catch-up.tsx, drawn by parts/ui/show/catch-up). `states` are open keys a source reports (this device, each device catching up, anything else that keeps a copy): each has its words (`label`, `label_one` for a count of one, `label_measured` when how far it got is measured; {count} and {percent} fill in), a `detail` line, a tone word (good, attention, bad, info, quiet), an icon, a `rank` (the highest ranking state any copy is in leads the mark), the `actions` it offers, `quiet` (nothing to show while it leads) and `moving` (work going on: the dot breathes). A state a source reports with no row here reads as its own words, quiet. `apart_state` is the state records kept as two versions put everything in, counted by how many, weighed by its rank against every copy's state. `ages` turn a copy that has not caught up in a while into another state. `actions` are the words of each action (what it does is the source's). `kinds` name the icon for a kind of device or record. `words` are every other word. Whether the mark shows at all, anywhere, is the person's show rules (subject `catch-up`, facts `state`, `tone`, `count`, `where`).
